nurse.text: Hello, love. Poole Sanctuary: ferry sick, sea sick, sick of seagulls, we treat the lot. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There you go, dear, have a sit. There's tea, and a lifeboat-shaped biscuit tin the volunteers keep topped up.
All done. Fit as a fiddle, and a lot fitter than anyone coming off the Guernsey boat in a swell.
The Ark's by the window. It's got a lovely view of the harbour and an unreasonable amount of salt on the glass.

else.text: Right you are. Mind the gulls on the quay, they've taken three of my sandwiches this year alone.
